position_sizing.conditional_logic: After a losing trade (Pribl<0), if currently using Lot1 (base), switch to Lot2 (recovery=7x base); if already on Lot2 and still losing, set PlanB flag to use Lot2 on next entry. After a winning trade (Pribl>=0), revert to Lot1. Lot sizes also scale up in tiers as account balance grows relative to initial balance.

custom_logic_notes: Martingale lot sizing: After a loss, switches from base lot (Lots1) to recovery lot (Lots3=7x base). After a win, reverts to base lot. Balance-graduated tiers: as account balance grows to 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x the initial balance, all lot sizes are proportionally scaled up. Entry timing gate: only enters within the first 15 minutes of a new H4 bar (str1.min<=15 && Vhod). Signal is derived from previous completed H4 bar direction (Close vs Open of bar index 1). Profit/loss tracking uses OnTradeTransaction to capture deal results. Symbol is hard-coded to EURUSD in signal logic. The SL:TP ratio is 240:40 = 6:1 (wide stop, tight target), making it a mean-reversion style with martingale recovery after losses.
python_conversion_notes: Key challenges: (1) Martingale lot sizing logic requires persistent state tracking of last trade result (Pribl) and PlanB flag across trades - need a trade result tracker that updates on position close. (2) Balance-tier lot scaling requires tracking minBalanse and maxBalance across the session. (3) H4 new-bar detection with 15-minute entry window needs precise bar-change timing. (4) OnTradeTransaction equivalent needed to capture deal P&L for martingale decisions. (5) The 6:1 SL:TP ratio with martingale recovery is high-risk and needs careful backtesting with tick data to verify fill assumptions. (6) Custom iOpen/iClose/iTime helper functions replicate MT4-style calls using CopyOpen/CopyClose/CopyTime - straightforward to replicate in Python. (7) Position counting filters by symbol and magic number.
